explication: Jenkins is an extensible automation server: users configure jobs, Jenkins schedules work, and build tasks support project building, testing, analysis, and deployment. Its runtime model includes jobs and runs, a queue and executors, agent nodes, SCM abstractions, plugin extensions, and administrative interfaces. The README establishes the product and automation capabilities; the tree identifies the relevant runtime areas. Sampled excerpts cover selected utilities and integrations, not the central scheduling or build implementation, so the graph shows only the principal documented relationships and avoids detailed internal call claims.
